gaps.explanation: p8 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds prints Water and Sewer enterprise columns; no business-type lines in detail[]. JSON receipts = operating revenues + interest income + insurance proceeds. Water: Charges for services 348,885 + Connect/disconnect fees 1,867 + Other revenue 121 + Interest income 44,039 + Insurance proceeds 8,452 = 403,364; Sewer: Charges for services 240,139 + Interest income 14,559 = 254,698. 403,364 + 254,698 = 658,062 = statement total.
